description: Proves a provisioned number can receive inbound voice calls

judges.description: TRUE if evidence shows an inbound call that rang/terminated on the exact number

gates.description: Evidence must be within freshness window

critical_rules: Provider's voice_in capability claim is not proof
Must be tested by independent caller placing actual call
Ring detected or call terminated on the number => TRUE
No ring, no termination, timeout => UNKNOWN
Busy signal or rejection => FALSE (capability denied)
